title: ConcatInventory
description: Every stream a concatenation input carries, as the selected muxer numbers them.

attachments.description: Source attachments. Empty when the probe failed.

chapter_count.description: Chapter count when the probe can report one; `None` means unknown, not zero.

data_stream_count.description: FFmpeg data streams, which are always copied and have no switch.

detail.description: Why the inventory is empty or partial, in language the screen can show.

method.description: The muxer this inventory came from.

tracks.description: Selectable source video, audio, and subtitle streams. Empty when the probe failed.

ConcatMethodName.description:
The muxer a concatenation inventory describes.

The two muxers number source streams in independent namespaces: mkvmerge uses the IDs
from `--identify`, FFmpeg uses the source stream index. A caller must never translate one
into the other.

ConcatSourceAttachment.description: One source attachment the selected muxer reports.

description.description: Description when the container records one.

key.description:
The muxer's attachment identifier. It shares a numeric namespace with track IDs for
mkvmerge, which is why `selectable` is false there.

label.description: The file name the attachment carries.

mime_type.description: MIME type when the container records one.

selectable.description: Whether the workbench may include or drop this attachment individually.

size_bytes.description: Size in bytes when the probe reports it.

ConcatSourceTrack.description: One selectable source stream, keyed by the selected muxer's own identifier.

channels.description: Channel count for an audio stream.

codec.description: Codec name as the probe reports it.

default.description: Whether the container marks this stream as the default.

forced.description: Whether the container marks this stream as forced.

key.description: mkvmerge track ID, or the FFmpeg source stream index. Never an ordinal.

kind.description: The stream's role, which decides the engine track variant and its option fields.

label.description: A stable, human-readable row label derived from the probe.

language.description: ISO 639 language tag when the container carries one.

name.description: The container's track title, when it has one.

ConcatTrackKind.description: What a selectable source stream carries.

oneOf.description: A picture stream; selectable only on an mkvmerge extra input.
